requirements.text: Specification row: Feature, 📰 Daily News Feed (`ram_chatbot-main`), 🔍 Current Affairs Mode (`RAG-main`)
Specification row: **Core Nature**, **Passive News Digest** (Curated daily reading feed), **Active Research Engine** (On-demand question answering)
Specification row: **Trigger Mechanism**, Automated cron job (06:00 AM daily), User submits a question
Specification row: **Data Scope**, Top ~10-16 pre-selected articles from *The Hindu* & *PIB*, Live web search across 15+ verified Indian portals
Specification row: **Output Format**, Structured 3-bullet points with GS category tag, In-depth analytical examination answer with source citations
Specification row: **Storage & Cache**, Stored in MongoDB / `daily_news.json` (5-day rolling window), Cached in SQLite
Specification row: **Student Usage**, Browsing the morning news summary, Asking specific analytical questions for Mains / Prelims
Right on the news card, students can click an **"Analyze with AI"** action button, which opens the chatbot with that specific article pre-loaded into context.
